title: \textbf{Proof}
body_md:
Let $T=U|T|$ be the polar decomposition of $T$. 
        
                        
                                                                                                 
    
         
Consider,
\begin{align}
\|\Re_t(e^{i\theta}T)\|_p
\nonumber &=\left\|
te^{i\theta}T + (1-t)e^{-i\theta}T^*
\right\|_p\\
\nonumber &=\left\|
te^{i\theta}T +te^{-i\theta}T^*+ (1-2t)e^{-i\theta}T^*
\right\|_p\\
\nonumber &=\left\|
te^{i\theta}T +te^{-i\theta}T^*\|_p+ \|(1-2t)e^{-i\theta}T^*
\right\|_p\\
\nonumber &=
t\left\|e^{i\theta}U|T|+e^{-i\theta}|T|U^*\right\|_p + |1-2t|\|e^{-i\theta}|T|U^*\|\\
    
                                                               
\nonumber &=
t\left\|
\begin{bmatrix}
e^{i\theta}Ug(|T|) & f(|T|)\\
0 & 0
\end{bmatrix}
\begin{bmatrix}
f(|T|) & 0\\
e^{-i\theta}g(|T|)U^* & 0
\end{bmatrix}
\right\|_p+|1-2t|\||T|\|_p
\end{align}
Here it is easy to see that the product $\begin{bmatrix}
e^{i\theta}Ug(|T|) & f(|T|)\\
0 & 0
\end{bmatrix}
\begin{bmatrix}
f(|T|) & 0\\
e^{-i\theta}g(|T|)U^* & 0
\end{bmatrix}$ is self adjoint. Since $T \in B_p(H)$, applying the Lemma \ref{lem1}, we have
\begin{align}\label{k2}
\nonumber \|\Re_t(e^{i\theta}T)\|_p&\le t
\left\|
\Re\left(
\begin{bmatrix}
f(|T|) & 0\\
e^{-i\theta}g(|T|)U^* & 0
\end{bmatrix}
\begin{bmatrix}
e^{i\theta}Ug(|T|) & f(|T|)\\
0 & 0
\end{bmatrix}
\right)
\right\|_p+|1-2t|\|T\|_p\\
                                                       
\nonumber &=
t\left\|\Re\left(
\begin{bmatrix}
e^{i\theta}f(|T|)Ug(|T|)
&
f^2(|T|)
\\[2mm]
g^2(|T|)
&
e^{-i\theta}g(|T|)U^*f(|T|)
\end{bmatrix}\right)
\right\|_p+|1-2t|\|T\|_p\\
\nonumber &=t
\left\|
\begin{bmatrix}
\Re(e^{i\theta}\widetilde{T}_{f,g})
&
\dfrac12\bigl(f^2(|T|)+g^2(|T|)\bigr)
\\[2mm]
\dfrac12\bigl(f^2(|T|)+g^2(|T|)\bigr)
&
\Re\left(e^{-i\theta}(\widetilde{T}_{f,g})^*\right)
\end{bmatrix}
\right\|_p+|1-2t|\|T\|_p\\
\nonumber &\le t
\left\|
\begin{bmatrix}
\Re(e^{i\theta}\widetilde{T}_{f,g}) & 0\\
0 & \Re\left(e^{-i\theta}(\widetilde{T}_{f,g})^*\right)
\end{bmatrix}
\right\|_p\\
\nonumber &\hspace{1cm}+\frac{1}{2}t
\left\|
\begin{bmatrix}
0 &
\bigl(f^2(|T|)+g^2(|T|)\bigr)
\\[2mm]
\bigl(f^2(|T|)+g^2(|T|)\bigr)
& 0
\end{bmatrix}
\right\|_p+|1-2t|\|T\|_p\\
\nonumber &=
2^{\frac1p}t
\left\|
\Re(e^{i\theta}\widetilde{T}_{f,g})
\right\|_p
+
2^{\frac1p-1}t
\left\|
f^2(|T|)+g^2(|T|)
\right\|_p+|1-2t|\|T\|_p\\
\nonumber &\hspace{5cm}(\text{Using} ~\eqref{qe1})\\
 &=
2^{\frac1p}t
\left[\left\|
\Re(e^{i\theta}\widetilde{T}_{f,g})
\right\|_p
+
\frac{1}{2}
\left\|
f^2(|T|)+g^2(|T|)
\right\|_p\right]+|1-2t|\|T\|_p.
\end{align}
By taking the supremum on both sides over $\theta \in \mathbb{R}$, we get 
\begin{align*}
w_{t,p}(T)\leq2^{\frac1p}t\left[
w_p(\widetilde{T}_{f,g})
+
\frac{1}{2}
\left\|
f^2(|T|)+g^2(|T|)
\right\|_p\right]+|1-2t|\|T\|_p.
\end{align*}

title: \textbf{Proof}
body_md:
Let \(T=U|T|\) be the polar decomposition of \(T\), and let
\(\theta\in\mathbb{R}\).
Consider,
\begin{align}
\nonumber (\Re_t(e^{i\theta}T))^2&=(te^{i\theta}T + (1-t)e^{-i\theta}T^*)^2 \\
&=t^2 e^{2i\theta}T^2 + (1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}T^{*2} + t(1-t)(T^*T + TT^*)\label{1w}\\
\nonumber &= t^2e^{2i\theta}U|T|U|T| + (1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}|T|U^*|T|U^* +t(1-t)(T^*T + TT^*)\\
\nonumber &= t^2e^{2i\theta}Ug(|T|)f(|T|) Ug(|T|)f(|T|) + (1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}f(|T|)g(|T|)U^*f(|T|) g(|T|)U^* \\
\nonumber &\hspace{4cm}
+ t(1-t)(T^*T + TT^*)\\
\nonumber &= t^2e^{2i\theta}Ug(|T|)\Tilde{T}_{f,g}~f(|T|) + (1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}f(|T|)(\Tilde{T}_{f,g})^*g(|T|)U^* 
\\ &\hspace{5cm}+ t(1-t)(T^*T + TT^*)\label{1w0}.
\end{align}
Thus,
\begin{align*}
\left\|
\bigl(\Re_t(e^{i\theta}T)\bigr)^2\right\|_{p}
&\le
t^2\left\|
Ug(|T|)\widetilde{T}_{f,g}f(|T|)
\right\|_{p}
+
(1-t)^2\left\|
f(|T|)(\widetilde{T}_{f,g})^*g(|T|)U^*
\right\|_{p}\\
&\hspace{2cm}+
t(1-t)\|T^*T+TT^*\|_{p}\\
&\le
t^2\left\|
g(|T|)\widetilde{T}_{f,g}f(|T|)
\right\|_{p}
+
(1-t)^2\left\|
f(|T|)(\widetilde{T}_{f,g})^*g(|T|)\right\|_{p}\\
&\hspace{2cm}+
t(1-t)\|T^*T+TT^*\|_{p}.
\end{align*}
By taking the supremum in the above inequality over
\(\theta\in\mathbb{R}\) and use \eqref{w0}, we get 
\begin{align*}
w_{t,2p}^2(T)
&\le
t^2\left\|
g(|T|)\widetilde{T}_{f,g}f(|T|)
\right\|_{p}
+
(1-t)^2\left\|
f(|T|)(\widetilde{T}_{f,g})^*g(|T|)
\right\|_{p}\\
&\hspace{2cm}+
t(1-t)\|T^*T+TT^*\|_{p}.
\end{align*}

title: \textbf{Proof}
body_md:
Consider,
\begin{align*}
&\left\|
\mathfrak{R}_t(e^{i\theta}T)
\right\|_{4p}^4\\
&=\left\| \left|te^{i\theta}T + (1-t)e^{-i\theta}T^*\right|^2\right\|^2_{2p}\\
&= 
\big\| t^2e^{2i\theta}T^2
+ (1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}(T^*)^2
+ t(1-t)(TT^* + T^*T)\big\|^2_{2p}\\
&= 
\big\|t^2e^{2i\theta}T^2
+ (1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}(T^*)^2+K\big\|^2_{2p}
\hspace{1cm}(~\text{taking}~ K=T^*T+TT^*)\\
&=
\big\|\left|
t^2e^{2i\theta}T^2 + (1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}(T^*)^2 + K
\right|^2\big\|_{p}\\
&=
\Bigl\|
\left(
t^2e^{2i\theta}T^2 + (1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}(T^*)^2
\right)^2+\left(
t^2e^{2i\theta}T^2 + (1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}(T^*)^2
\right)K
\\
\nonumber &\qquad\quad
+K\left(
t^2e^{2i\theta}T^2 + (1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}(T^*)^2
\right)
+K^2
\Bigr\|_{p}\\
 &=
\Bigl\|
\left(
t^2e^{2i\theta}T^2 + (1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}(T^*)^2
\right)^2+t^2e^{2i\theta}T^2 K
+(1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}(T^*)^2 K
\\
&\qquad\quad
+Kt^2e^{2i\theta}T^2
+K(1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}(T^*)^2
+K^2
\Bigr\|_{p}
\\
&=
\Bigl\|
\left(
t^2e^{2i\theta}T^2 + (1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}(T^*)^2
\right)^2
\\
&\qquad\quad
+t^2e^{2i\theta}(T^2K+KT^2)
+(1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}\bigl((T^*)^2K+K(T^*)^2\bigr)
+K^2
\Bigr\|_{p}\\
&\le
\Bigl\|
\big|t^2e^{2i\theta}T^2+(1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}(T^*)^2\big|^2
\Bigr\|_{p}
\\
&
+
\left\|
t^2e^{2i\theta}(T^2K+KT^2)
\right\|_{p}+\left\|(1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}\bigl((T^*)^2K+K(T^*)^2\bigr)\right\|_{p}
+\||K|^2\|_{p}
\\
&=
\Bigl\|
t^2e^{2i\theta}U|T|U|T|
+
(1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}|T|U^*|T|U^*
\Bigr\|^2_{2p}
\\
&\qquad
+
t^2\left\|
(T^2K+KT^2)
\right\|_{p}+(1-t)^2\left\|(T^*)^2K+K(T^*)^2\right\|_{p}
+\|K\|^2_{2p}
\\
&= \left\|t^2e^{2i\theta}U|T|^{1-\mathsf{s}}|T|^\mathsf{s} U|T|^{1-\mathsf{s}}|T|^\mathsf{s} + (1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}|T|^\mathsf{s}|T|^{1-\mathsf{s}}U^*|T|^\mathsf{s} |T|^{1-\mathsf{s}}U^*\right\|^2_{2p} \\
&\qquad
+
t^2\left\|
(T^2K+KT^2)
\right\|_{p}+(1-t)^2\left\|(T^*)^2K+K(T^*)^2\right\|_{p}
+\|K\|^2_{2p}
\\
&=\left\| t^2e^{2i\theta}U|T|^{1-\mathsf{s}}\widetilde{T}_\mathsf{s}|T|^\mathsf{s} 
+ (1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}|T|^\mathsf{s}\widetilde{T}_\mathsf{s}^*|T|^{1-\mathsf{s}}U^* \right\|^2_{2p}\\
&\qquad
+
t^2\left\|
(T^2K+KT^2)
\right\|_{p}+(1-t)^2\left\|(T^*)^2K+K(T^*)^2\right\|_{p}
+\|K\|^2_{2p}\\
&\leq \Bigl(t^2\left\| e^{2i\theta}U|T|^{1-\mathsf{s}}\widetilde{T}_\mathsf{s}|T|^\mathsf{s} \right\|_{2p}
+ (1-t)^2\left\| e^{-2i\theta}|T|^\mathsf{s}\widetilde{T}_\mathsf{s}^*|T|^{1-\mathsf{s}}U^* \right\|_{2p}\Bigr)^2\\
&\qquad
+
t^2\left\|
T^2K+KT^2
\right\|_{p}+(1-t)^2\left\|(T^*)^2K+K(T^*)^2\right\|_p
+\|K\|^2_{2p}
\\
&\leq \{t^2+(1-t)^2\}^2\|T\|^2_{2p}\|\widetilde{T}_\mathsf{s}\|^2_{2p} \\
&\qquad
+
t^2\left\|
T^2K+KT^2
\right\|_{p}+(1-t)^2\left\|(T^*)^2K+K(T^*)^2\right\|_{p}
+\|K\|^2_{2p}.
\end{align*}
Taking supremum over \(\theta \in \mathbb{R}\) in the above inequality, we get
\begin{align*}
w_{t,4p}^4(T) &\leq \{t^2+(1-t)^2\}^2\|T\|^2_{2p}\|\widetilde{T}_\mathsf{s}\|^2_{2p} \\
&\qquad
+
t^2\left\|
(T^2K+KT^2
\right\|_{p}+(1-t)^2\left\|(T^*)^2K+K(T^*)^2\right\|_{p}
+\|K\|^2_{2p}.
\end{align*}

title: Theorem
body_md:
For $T\in B(H)$, $\mathsf{s}\in [0,1]$ and $m\ge 1$, we have
\[
w_t^{2m}(T)
\leq 2^{2(m-1)}\Big(\{t^{2m}+(1-t)^{2m}\}\|T\|^m\|\widetilde{T}_\mathsf{s}\|^m+t^m(1-t)^m\left\|

title: \textbf{Proof}
body_md:
From \eqref{1w}, we get
\begin{align*}
(\Re_t(e^{i\theta}T) )^2
&= t^2e^{2i\theta}T^2 + (1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}T^{*2} +t(1-t)(T^*T + TT^*).
\end{align*}
Therefore,
\begin{align*}
\|(\Re_t(e^{i\theta}T) )^2\|
&\le\left\|t^2e^{2i\theta}T^2 + (1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}T^{*2}\right\|
+t(1-t)\|T^*T+TT^*\|.
\end{align*}
Now,
\begin{align*}
&\|(\Re_t(e^{i\theta}T) )^2\|^m=\|\Re_t(e^{i\theta}T) \|^{2m}\\
&\le
\Big(
\left\|t^2e^{2i\theta}T^2 + (1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}T^{*2}\right\|
+t(1-t)\|T^*T+TT^*\|
\Big)^m \\
&\le
2^{p-1}\Big(\left\|t^2e^{2i\theta}T^2 + (1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}T^{*2}\right\|^m
+t^m(1-t)^m\left\|{T^*T+TT^*}\right\|^m\Big) \\
&=2^{m-1}\Bigg(\Bigl\|
t^2e^{2i\theta}U|T|U|T|
+
(1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}|T|U^*|T|U^*
\Bigr\|^m\\
&\hspace{5cm}+2^m t^m(1-t)^m\left\|\frac{T^*T+TT^*}{2}\right\|^m\Bigg)\\
&\leq2^{m-1}\Bigg(\Big\|t^2e^{2i\theta}U|T|^{1-\mathsf{s}}|T|^\mathsf{s} U|T|^{1-\mathsf{s}}|T|^\mathsf{s} + (1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}|T|^\mathsf{s}|T|^{1-\mathsf{s}}U^*|T|^\mathsf{s} |T|^{1-\mathsf{s}}U^*\Big\|^m\\
&\hspace{3cm}+2^m t^m(1-t)^m\left\|
\left(
\frac{(T^*T)^m+(TT^*)^m}{2}
\right)^{\frac{1}{m}}
\right\|^m\Bigg) \\
&\leq2^{m-1}\Bigg(\left\| t^2e^{2i\theta}U|T|^{1-\mathsf{s}}\widetilde{T}_\mathsf{s}|T|^\mathsf{s} 
+ (1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}|T|^\mathsf{s}\widetilde{T}_\mathsf{s}^*|T|^{1-\mathsf{s}}U^* \right\|^m\\
&\hspace{6cm}+2^m t^m(1-t)^m\left\|
\frac{(T^*T)^m+(TT^*)^m}{2}
\right\|\Bigg)\\
&\leq2^{m-1}\Bigg(2^{m-1}\Big(\left\| t^2e^{2i\theta}U|T|^{1-\mathsf{s}}\widetilde{T}_\mathsf{s}|T|^\mathsf{s}\right\| 
+ \left\|(1-t)^2e^{-2i\theta}|T|^\mathsf{s}\widetilde{T}_\mathsf{s}^*|T|^{1-\mathsf{s}}U^* \right\|^m\Big)\\
&\hspace{6cm}+2^{m-1} t^m(1-t)^m\left\|
{(T^*T)^m+(TT^*)^m}
\right\|\Bigg)\\
&=2^{2(m-1)}\Bigg(t^{2m}\left\| U|T|^{1-\mathsf{s}}\widetilde{T}_\mathsf{s}|T|^\mathsf{s}\right\| 
+ (1-t)^{2m}\left\||T|^\mathsf{s}\widetilde{T}_\mathsf{s}^*|T|^{1-\mathsf{s}}U^* \right\|^m\\
&\hspace{6cm}+t^m(1-t)^m\left\|
{(T^*T)^m+(TT^*)^m}
\right\|\Bigg)\\
&\leq 2^{2(m-1)}\Big(\{t^{2m}+(1-t)^{2m}\}\|T\|^m\|\widetilde{T}_\mathsf{s}\|^m+t^m(1-t)^m\left\|
{(T^*T)^m+(TT^*)^m}
\right\|\Big).
\end{align*}
\noindent Taking the supremum over $\theta\in\mathbb{R}$ in the above inequality, we get

\[
w_t^{2m}(T)
\leq 2^{2(m-1)}\Big(\{t^{2m}+(1-t)^{2m}\}\|T\|^m\|\widetilde{T}_\mathsf{s}\|^m+t^m(1-t)^m\left\|
{(T^*T)^m+(TT^*)^m}
\right\|\Big).
\]

body_md:

Consider,
        
                        
                                                                                                 
    
         
Consider,
\begin{align*}

title: Theorem
body_md:
\label{b5} 
 For $1 \leq p\leq \infty$, $t \in [0,1]$ and $T,S \in B_p(H)$,  If $f,g$ are non-negative continuous functions on $[0,\infty)$ such that $f(x)g(x)=x$, 
we have
\begin{align}\label{e5}
w_{t,p}\!\left(
\begin{bmatrix}
0 & T\\
S & 0
\end{bmatrix}
\right)
\nonumber&\le
  2^\frac{1}{p}t\Bigg[
2^{\frac{1}{p}-1}\left(\bigl\|f(|S|)g(|T^*|)\bigr\|_p+\bigl\|f(|T|)g(|S^*|)\bigr\|_p
\right)\\
&\nonumber\hspace{2cm}+\frac{1}{2}\Bigl(\|f^2(|S|)+g^2(|S|)\|_p^p+\|f^2(|T|)+g^2(|T|)\|_p^p\Bigr)^{\frac1p}\Bigg]\\
&\hspace{2cm}+|1-2t|
\bigl(\|T\|_p^p+\|S\|_p^p\bigr)^{\frac1p}.
\end{align}
head: environment

title: \textbf{Proof}
body_md:
Let $T=U|T|$ and $S=V|S|$ be the polar decompositions of $T$ and $S$, respectively.
For $\mathbb{E}=\begin{bmatrix}
0 & T\\
S & 0
\end{bmatrix}$, we have
\begin{align*}\Tilde{\mathbb{E}}_{f,g}&=f(|\mathbb{E}|)\begin{bmatrix}
0 & U\\
V & 0
\end{bmatrix}g(|\mathbb{E}|)\\
&=\begin{bmatrix}
f(|S|) & 0\\
0 & f(|T|)
\end{bmatrix}
\begin{bmatrix}
0 & U\\
V & 0
\end{bmatrix}
\begin{bmatrix}
g(|S|) & 0\\
0 & g(|T|)
\end{bmatrix}
\end{align*}
and
\begin{align*}
\left\|
f^2(|\mathbb{E}|)+g^2(|\mathbb{E}|)
\right\|_p=\left\|\begin{bmatrix}
f^2(|S|)+g^2(|S|) & 0\\
0 & f^2(|T|)+g^2(|T|)
\end{bmatrix}\right\|_p.
\end{align*}
From \eqref{0c1}, we obtain
\begin{align*}
&w_{t,p}\left(
\begin{bmatrix}
0 & T\\
S & 0
\end{bmatrix}
\right)\\
&\leq2^{\frac1p}t\left[
w_p(\Tilde{\mathbb{E}}_{f,g})
+
\frac{1}{2}
\left\|
f^2(|\mathbb{E}|)+g^2(|\mathbb{E}|)
\right\|_p\right]+|1-2t|\|\mathbb{E}\|_p\\
&\le 2^\frac{1}{p}t\Bigg[
w_p\!\left(
\begin{bmatrix}
f(|S|) & 0\\
0 & f(|T|)
\end{bmatrix}
\begin{bmatrix}
0 & U\\
V & 0
\end{bmatrix}
\begin{bmatrix}
g(|S|) & 0\\
0 & g(|T|)
\end{bmatrix}
\right)\\
&\hspace{2cm}+\frac{1}{2}\left\|\begin{bmatrix}
f^2(|S|)+g^2(|S|) & 0\\
0 & f^2(|T|)+g^2(|T|)
\end{bmatrix}\right\|_p\Bigg]+|1-2t|
\left\|
\begin{bmatrix}
0 & T\\
S & 0
\end{bmatrix}
\right\|_p\\
&=
2^\frac{1}{p}t\Bigg[
w_p\!\left(
\begin{bmatrix}
0 & f(|S|)Ug(|T|)\\
f(|T|)Vg(|S|) & 0
\end{bmatrix}
\right)\\
&\hspace{2cm}+\frac{1}{2}\Bigl(\|f^2(|S|)+g^2(|S|)\|_p^p+\|f^2(|T|)+g^2(|T|)\|_p^p\Bigr)^{\frac1p}\Bigg]+ |1-2t|
\bigl(\|T\|_p^p+\|S\|_p^p\bigr)^{\frac1p}
\\
&\le
 2^\frac{1}{p}t\Bigg[
w_p\!\left(
\begin{bmatrix}
0 & f(|S|)Ug(|T|)\\
0 & 0
\end{bmatrix}
\right)
+
w_p\!\left(
\begin{bmatrix}
0 & 0\\
f(|T|)Vg(|S|) & 0
\end{bmatrix}
\right)\\
&\hspace{2cm}+\frac{1}{2}\Bigl(\|f^2(|S|)+g^2(|S|)\|_p^p+\|f^2(|T|)+g^2(|T|)\|_p^p\Bigr)^{\frac1p}\Bigg]+|1-2t|
\bigl(\|T\|_p^p+\|S\|_p^p\bigr)^{\frac1p}
\\
&=
 2^\frac{1}{p}t\Big[2^{\frac{1}{p}-1}
\bigl\|f(|S|)Ug(|T|)\bigr\|_p
+
2^{\frac{1}{p}-1}\bigl\|f(|T|)Vg(|S|)\bigr\|_p\\
&\hspace{1cm}+\frac{1}{2}\Bigl(\|f^2(|S|)+g^2(|S|)\|_p^p+\|f^2(|T|)+g^2(|T|)\|_p^p\Bigr)^{\frac1p}\Big]+|1-2t|
\bigl(\|T\|_p^p+\|S\|_p^p\bigr)^{\frac1p}
\\
&\hspace{7cm} (\text{by the inequality} \eqref{2})\\
&=
 2^\frac{1}{p}t\Bigg[
2^{\frac{1}{p}-1}\left(\bigl\|f(|S|)UU^*g(|T^*|)U\bigr\|_p+
\bigl\|f(|T|)VV^*g(|S^*|)V\bigr\|_p
\right)\\
&\hspace{1cm}+\frac{1}{2}\Bigl(\|f^2(|S|)+g^2(|S|)\|_p^p+\|f^2(|T|)+g^2(|T|)\|_p^p\Bigr)^{\frac1p}\Bigg]+|1-2t|
\bigl(\|T\|_p^p+\|S\|_p^p\bigr)^{\frac1p}\\
&\hspace{3cm}(\text{since}~ g(|T|)=U^*g(|T^*|)U, ~\text{and}~ g(|S|)=V^*g(|S^*|)V 
)\\
&=
 2^\frac{1}{p}t\Bigg[
2^{\frac{1}{p}-1}\left(\bigl\|f(|S|)g(|T^*|)U\bigr\|_p+
\bigl\|f(|T|)g(|S^*|)V\bigr\|_p
\right)\\
&\hspace{1cm}+\frac{1}{2}\Bigl(\|f^2(|S|)+g^2(|S|)\|_p^p+\|f^2(|T|)+g^2(|T|)\|_p^p\Bigr)^{\frac1p}\Bigg]+|1-2t|
\bigl(\|T\|_p^p+\|S\|_p^p\bigr)^{\frac1p}\\
&\leq
 2^\frac{1}{p}t\Bigg[
2^{\frac{1}{p}-1}\left(\bigl\|f(|S|)g(|T^*|)\bigr\|_p+
\bigl\|f(|T|)g(|S^*|)\bigr\|_p
\right)\\
&\hspace{1cm}+\frac{1}{2}\Bigl(\|f^2(|S|)+g^2(|S|)\|_p^p+\|f^2(|T|)+g^2(|T|)\|_p^p\Bigr)^{\frac1p}\Bigg]+|1-2t|
\bigl(\|T\|_p^p+\|S\|_p^p\bigr)^{\frac1p}\\
&\hspace{7cm} (\text{by the inequality} \eqref{2}).
\end{align*}
Hence the proved.
